_comment: First learned candidate for M6, frozen 2026-10-17 before the native holdout was consulted. Chosen on validation only (reports/backtest_models.json): ridge with core features beat LightGBM (26.49 vs 27.20 EUR/MWh) and the 180-day window edged the expanding one (26.49 vs 26.56). Settings are those of configs/backtest_models.json; nothing here was tuned on the holdout.
name: ridge-core-180-v1
